title: Vector Quantized Diffusion Model for Text-to-Image Synthesis

openAccessPdf.disclaimer: Notice: Paper or abstract available at https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.14822, which is subject to the license by the author or copyright owner provided with this content. Please go to the source to verify the license and copyright information for your use.

tldr.text: This method is based on a vector quantized variational autoencoder whose latent space is modeled by a conditional variant of the recently developed Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM), and it is found that this latent-space method is well-suited for text-to-image generation tasks.
